title: Surface Authority Taxonomy
description: Schema for surface authority taxonomy artifacts: audits, maps, models, registers, test strategies, roadmaps, and spine definitions.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Always rig.relay.surface_authority_taxonomy.v1 for this schema family.

content_light.description: Whether this artifact is safe for content-light transmission (no secrets, no raw file contents). Must be true for all governance artifacts.

audit_id.description: Unique identifier for audit artifacts. Required when this document is a surface authority taxonomy audit.

map_id.description: Unique identifier for surface map artifacts. Required when this document is a surface authority taxonomy map.

model_id.description: Unique identifier for model artifacts. Required when this document is a surface authority taxonomy model definition.

register_id.description: Unique identifier for register artifacts. Required when this document is a surface authority taxonomy register.

strategy_id.description: Unique identifier for test strategy artifacts. Required when this document is a surface test strategy.

roadmap_id.description: Unique identifier for roadmap artifacts. Required when this document is a surface roadmap.

spine_id.description: Unique identifier for governance spine definition artifacts. Required when this document is a governance spine definition.

taxonomy_id.description: Unique identifier for taxonomy definition artifacts. Required when this document is a surface authority taxonomy definition.

name.description: Human-readable name of the protocol surface.

description.description: Description of the surface and its role.

transport.description: Transport mechanism (e.g., WebSocket, HTTP, stdio, SSH).

tool_tiers_exposed.description: MCP tool tiers exposed on this surface.

mutation_allowed.description: Whether this surface allows mutation operations.

content_light_enforced.description: Whether content-light scanning is enforced on this surface.

receipt_backed.description: Whether operations on this surface produce receipts.

requires_approval.description: Whether operations at this tier require human approval.

requires_receipt.description: Whether operations at this tier require a receipt.

level.description: Maturity level of the surface implementation.

label.description: Human-readable label for this maturity level.

tests_exist.description: Whether tests exist for this surface at this maturity level.

model.description: Identity model used by this surface.

description.description: How identity is established and verified on this surface.

scopes.description: Authorization scopes available under this identity model.
